_comment: Content-package shape consumed by social-publishing-guardian. One file per publish run. Fill placeholders; the Guardian resolves accountIds/userId at run time and builds the provider payload (see guides/04-create-post-payload.md and guides/08-zernio-runbook.md). Every post is created as a DRAFT.
locationId: <GHL location id, or null for non-GHL providers>

defaults.scheduleDateHint: <ISO-8601, non-binding on a GHL draft; e.g. 2026-07-08T18:00:00Z>

posts.postKey: <stable id for this logical post; used for the manifest key>
posts.summary: <post body text. Must fit the MOST RESTRICTIVE target platform's char cap; Bluesky=300. See guides/07-media-attachment.md>

media.url: <PUBLIC https URL; the provider fetches it. Within per-platform size caps; Bluesky=1MB. [] for text-only>

posts._perChannelCustomNote: Set true to send DIFFERENT copy per platform (forces one create call per platform). false = one identical post fanned out to all platforms in a single call.
